episode.title: Loaves Of Bread From 79 AD Were Preserved In Pompeii

synopsis: Intact carbonized loaves of bread from 79 AD were discovered inside a brick oven in ancient Pompeii.

Shot 1, exactly 10 seconds at 24 fps, ONE continuous unbroken shot with no cuts. Inside a dark ruined stone bakery in Pompeii, a brick dome oven holds round carbonized loaves of bread resting on ash. Warm low evening sunlight streams through a crumbling doorway, illuminating floating dust particles. Fine volcanic ash slowly drifts down through the air. The camera executes a slow, smooth push-in toward the open oven mouth throughout the full ten seconds.

title_card.title: Bread from 79 AD survived in Pompeii.
title_card.subtitle: Volcanic ash preserved intact carbonized loaves.

caption:
Loaves of bread from 79 AD were found preserved inside an oven in Pompeii.

During the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 0079 AD, intense heat instantly carbonized loaves of bread inside stone ovens. Excavations in 1879 uncovered these intact loaves sealed beneath thick volcanic ash.
